skill: M07 裂地重踏（隼妖精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright falcon warrior in the reference performs ONE heavy ground stomp in place. From the resting pose it slowly lifts its right taloned leg high with the knee bent and half opens the wings for balance, then slams the talons down hard, the whole body dropping into a low wide stance with the wings spread low, holds the low impact pose briefly, then straightens, folds the wings and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, falcon head and beak, feathers, wings, armor and kilt. No jump, flying, punch, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: first second and a half lift the leg, a sudden stomp around two seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
